description: Composite workflow for music-for-picture needs: "dark tracks for a cyberpunk game trailer", "upbeat song for a sports ad". One call returns matched tracks with why-each-fits, verified ISRCs, sync-clearance status, and concrete next steps. A match is NOT a license grant — clearance still requires a brief.

brief.description: Natural-language music brief, e.g. "tense instrumental for a heist scene". Truncated at 500 characters.

explicit.description: true = explicit only, false = non-explicit only. Omit for all.

name: find_tracks_for_brief

outputSchema.description: find_tracks_for_brief response: matched tracks with fit reasons, verified ISRCs, clearance summary, next steps.

_session.description: Chain session: pass _session.session_token back in the next call to continue the chain.

session_token.description: Hex session token; echo it as params._session.session_token to continue.

step.description: Hop number in this chain (1 = chain start).

clearance_summary.description: Plain-language clearance status for the matched tracks: who controls master+publishing, one-signature terms, PRO.

licensing_disclaimer.description: States that a match is not a license grant.

next_steps.description: Concrete actions: submit_sync_brief with the brief, contact email, license terms URL.

best_link.description: Best available listen link: presave (unreleased) > Spotify > Apple Music, with kind label.

isrc.description: Verified ISRC from the query-db, or null when not on file. Never invented.

why_it_fits.description: Concrete descriptor matches, e.g. 'mood: aggressive', 'scene: fight scene'.

try_next.description: Suggested follow-up calls, each a pre-compiled {tool, arguments, purpose} payload.

items.description: Pre-compiled next call: copy `arguments` straight into the next tools/call.

arguments.description: Ready-to-use arguments, pre-populated from the current response.

purpose.description: Why this call is the natural next step.

title: Find Tracks for a Brief
